description:
Turn any receipt into structured, accounting-ready JSON or clean Markdown with one API call. AI-powered vision extracts        
  merchant, date, line items, tax breakdown, totals, currency, and confidence scores — then suggests the right GL account for 
  instant bookkeeping. 7 tools for the full receipt-to-journal-entry pipeline. Built for expense automation agents. 50 free      
  credits on signup, no credit card required.
